verdict.rationale: Airweave syncs documents and attachments from connected sources (e.g. Airtable attachments, Google Drive/Notion documents) into a searchable knowledge collection, which implies some file-based content becomes searchable later, but there is no explicit evidence of direct image/PDF upload as 'memory input' or of image-specific processing (OCR, vision extraction) for recall. Missing for 10: explicit support for uploading standalone files/images as memory inputs (outside of full source-connector syncs), documented image/PDF content extraction, and any hands-on demonstration of recalling information from an uploaded file or image.
